messages.subject: what happens during reconnecting ?
parts:
Hi, 

I keep strugling with a "disconnected from server" error in my shiny app while running it on shiny.io server. Due to the characteristics of the problem I can only come up with one possible cause namely that something goes wrong when server and client try to reconnect after the connection was lost. Is it possible that due to reconnecting, the vector "resp" somehow stores multiple or zero answers per OK button click ? The code looks like this: 

observeEvent(input$OK,{ 
      if (input$OK > n  ){
         reac_vars$resp<-c(reac_vars$resp, input$survey)
      }
})

because:
-In the error log it sais that the length of the resp vector is not correct (different amount of answers stored than questions asked ). That is why my computations fail and the app crashes. 
-I never have this problem locally.
-I never have the problem myself online (on my computer, with a stable internet connection).
-Not everyone has the problem online (1 out of 5 people). 
-I can see that reconnect happens in the log.

Kind regards, 
Frits
